parameter_decode.bit7: span/concealed mode; when clear the low seven bits are not read (fixed springs use only 0/1 via the strength byte)
parameter_decode.low7: trigger width in pixels = low7 * 16 (four SLA/RL steps; stored at object +$34/+$35)
parameter_decode.strength: object +$3F is rewritten to 1 (weak) and then to 0 (strong) only when placement aux1 (object +$09) is zero; both span records have aux1 $72, so spans are weak
parameter_decode.packing: $88 = bit7 + low7 $08 -> 128 px; $8A = bit7 + low7 $0A -> 160 px. No other bit is tested by the initializer, contact or launch code.
